recommended_route: Reuse the appropriate included metal Clarks IS adapter and reproduce its 51 mm frame-side interface; preserve the stock caliper bolts and washer stack. Front and rear adapters differ. Alternatively use correct PM74.17 geometry. Either route still requires correct rotor-plane and radial alignment, plus clearance for caliper adjustment and cable.
